description: List Schedule 13D / 13G beneficial-ownership filings (and their amendments, 13D/A and 13G/A) for one issuer — AUTHORITATIVE source for "who owns 5%+ of $TICKER" and "has an activist filed a 13D on this company". Takes a ticker or company name (auto-resolved to CIK) or a CIK directly. Each row flags `structured: true/false` — filings from SEC's 2024 XML rule onward are structured and feed straight into sec_13d_filing; older ones are plain text/HTML only. Use sec_13d_filing on any accession_number returned here to get the actual reporting-owner data (percent of class, voting power, purpose).

form_type.description: Filter to one form family. "13D" / "13G" exclude amendments; "13D/A" / "13G/A" are amendments only. Default "all".

ticker_or_cik.description: Stock ticker ("GME"), company name ("GameStop"), or SEC CIK, of the ISSUER whose beneficial-ownership filings to list.

name: sec_13d_filings
title: Sec 13d Filings
